title: Zesty Spanish Chicken Paella Valenciana
description: A light and garlicky Spanish dish featuring ssamjang, air-fried to perfection, served on a talavera plate, garlic-free for a sick day meal.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together ssamjang, smoked paprika, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Add the chicken to the air fryer and cook for 12 minutes, or until cooked through.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the uncooked rice to the saucepan and stir to coat the rice in oil.
Add the chicken broth to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender.
To serve, place the cooked rice on a talavera plate, top with the air-fried chicken, and garnish with lemon wedges.
